book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, no translation used

sentences.ar: كوخين، جنب بعض، عالطريق، تحت التلة.
sentences.en: Two cottages, side by side, on the road, below the hill.

sentences.ar: بكل واحد عيلة فلاحين، وبكل عيلة أربع أولاد.
sentences.en: In each a peasant family, and in each family four children.
The first family, the Tuvaches.
And the second, the Vallins.

sentences.ar: والأولاد التمانية بيلعبوا سوا عالطريق من الصبح للمسا.
sentences.en: And the eight children played together on the road from morning to evening.
Dirty, and no one told them apart.
And the food: soup, potatoes, bread.
And every day the same.

sentences.ar: والأم بتعبي الصحون، والأولاد بياكلوا زي الخنازير، والأب بياكل واقف.
sentences.en: And the mother filled the bowls, the children ate like pigs, and the father ate standing.
And so it was.

sentences.ar: وبيوم، وقفت عربية حلوة قدام الكوخين.
sentences.en: And one day, a fine carriage stopped in front of the cottages.

sentences.ar: وفيها سيدة شابة، وزوجها، من المدينة.
sentences.en: And in it a young lady, and her husband, from the city.

sentences.ar: والسيدة نزلت، وحملت أصغر ولد، ابن تيفاش، وباسته، وأعطته حلويات.
sentences.en: And the lady got down, picked up the smallest child, the Tuvaches' boy, kissed him, and gave him sweets.
And came back the next week, and the one after.

sentences.ar: وبيوم، دخلت الكوخ، وقعدت مع الأم، وقالت:
sentences.en: And one day, she went into the cottage, sat with the mother, and said:

sentences.ar: يا سيدة تيفاش، أنا ما عندي أولاد.
sentences.en: Madame Tuvache, I have no children.
And my husband is very rich.
I want to take your little one, Charlot.

sentences.ar: بربيه، وبعلمه، وبيصير سيد، وبيورث كل شي.
sentences.en: I will raise him, educate him, he will be a gentleman, and inherit everything.

sentences.ar: وبعطيكم مية فرنك بالشهر، طول حياتكم.
sentences.en: And I give you a hundred francs a month, for life.
And you see him whenever you like.

sentences.ar: الأم وقفت، ووجهها أحمر، وقالت: بدك تشتري ابني؟
sentences.en: The mother stood, her face red, and said: you want to buy my son?
The lady said: not buying!
Raising!
The mother screamed: get out!
Children are not for sale!
Get out!
And the lady left, weeping.

sentences.ar: وراحت للكوخ التاني، لعيلة فاليان، وعرضت نفس الشي.
sentences.en: And went to the other cottage, to the Vallins, and offered the same.

sentences.ar: والأب فاليان قعد يفكر، وسأل: مية فرنك بالشهر؟
sentences.en: And Father Vallin sat thinking, and asked: a hundred francs a month?
Written before a notary?
The lady said: written.

sentences.ar: قالت الأم فاليان: بس مية قليل.
sentences.en: Mother Vallin said: but a hundred is little.
Make it a hundred and twenty.

sentences.ar: وأخدوا الولد، جين، وراحوا فيه بالعربية.
sentences.en: And they took the boy, Jean, and drove off with him in the carriage.
And he cried.

sentences.ar: ومن هاليوم، الأم تيفاش صارت أشرف ست بالقرية.
sentences.en: And from that day, Mother Tuvache became the most honourable woman in the village.

sentences.ar: كانت تقول لكل واحد: أنا ما بعت ابني.
sentences.en: She would say to everyone: I did not sell my son.
I am not like those people.

sentences.ar: وكل ما تشوف جارتها، تبصق، وتقول: باعت ابنها.
sentences.en: And every time she saw her neighbour, she spat, and said: she sold her son.

sentences.ar: وشارلو، كل يوم، كان يسمع: إنت ابن الشرف.
sentences.en: And Charlot, every day, heard: you are the son of honour.
Your mother did not sell you.

sentences.ar: وكبر، وصار شاب، وبيشتغل بالحقول، وياكل شوربة، وبطاطا، وخبز.
sentences.en: And he grew up, became a young man, working in the fields, eating soup, potatoes, bread.

sentences.ar: وبيوم، وصلت عربية حلوة، وفيها سيد شاب، لابس منيح، وساعة ذهب.
sentences.en: And one day, a fine carriage arrived, and in it a young gentleman, well dressed, with a gold watch.

sentences.ar: ونزل، ودخل كوخ فاليان، وقال: بابا.
sentences.en: And got down, and went into the Vallin cottage, and said: father.
Mother.
Jean.

sentences.ar: والقرية كلها إجت تشوف، والأب والأم فاليان بيبكوا من الفرح.
sentences.en: And the whole village came to see, and Father and Mother Vallin wept for joy.

sentences.ar: وبالمسا، شارلو دخل كوخه، والشوربة عالطاولة.
sentences.en: And in the evening, Charlot went into his cottage, the soup on the table.
And looked at his father and mother, and said: fools.
The mother said: what?
He said: fools.
I would have been the one in the carriage.
I would have been the gentleman.

sentences.ar: قالت الأم، وهي بتبكي: إحنا ما بعناك!
sentences.en: The mother said, weeping: we did not sell you!
We refused!
He said: and that is what I blame you for.
And went out, and shut the door.
And went, and did not come back.
